name: spij-idx
description: Current, systematized corpus of Peruvian laws and regulations, taken from public SPIJ, the Peruvian Legal Information System of the Ministry of Justice.

defaultPrompt: ¿Qué dice el artículo 949 del Código Civil?
¿Cuáles son los criterios para aplicar el principio de oportunidad en el proceso penal?
¿Cómo está organizada la Ley del Procedimiento Administrativo General?

positive.prompt: ¿Qué dice el artículo 1969 del Código Civil?
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes article 1969 of the Peruvian Civil Code (liability for damage caused by fault or intent) verbatim and cites the article.

positive.prompt: ¿Cuál es el plazo para apelar una sentencia en un proceso sumarísimo?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from article 556 of the Civil Procedure Code (appeal in summary proceedings) and cites the article.

positive.description: Show the outline of a law
positive.prompt: ¿Cuál es el índice sistemático de la Ley 27444?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the structure of the General Administrative Procedure Law (preliminary title, titles and chapters) with their article ranges.
Lists the labor laws in the catalog, such as severance pay (CTS), working hours, collective labor relations and the labor productivity law.

positive.description: Read an article with its amendment notes
positive.prompt: ¿Qué modificaciones ha tenido el artículo 20 del Código Penal?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains article 20 of the Criminal Code (exemption from criminal liability) and the amendments recorded by SPIJ.

negative.description: Law of another country (SPIJ IDx only covers Peru)
negative.prompt: ¿Qué dice la Ley de Enjuiciamiento Civil de España sobre el proceso?

negative.description: Market data or news (SPIJ IDx has none)
negative.prompt: ¿Cuál es el tipo de cambio del dólar hoy en Perú?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.1: more precise tool descriptions about what each tool returns and in which order they are used; reading more than 20 articles returns the first 20 and the list of the remaining ones instead of an error; error messages that name the law queried and say how to proceed. Same tools and parameters.
